# Lakeshore Heating & Cooling

> Heating and cooling requests for Lakeshore. Furnace repair covers diagnosing and correcting faults in gas, propane, and oil furnaces.

Email: contact@lakeshoreheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://lakeshoreheatingcooling.ca

Request locations: Lakeshore, Windsor, LaSalle, Tecumseh, Amherstburg, Leamington, Belle River, Essex. Coverage and availability require provider confirmation.
